m1_terrain.desc: Spherical planets: cube-sphere quadtree terrain LOD, height functions per biome, terrain shader, collision patch, water-level logic, Planet node API

m2_sky.desc: Sky, stars, galaxy backdrop, sun light, day/night, atmosphere post-process, clouds, ocean surface, star visual (corona/flare), gas giants + rings

m3_ship.desc: Player ship: flight model, pulse drive, landing/take-off, atmospheric entry, cameras, VFX

m4_player.desc: On-foot player: spherical-gravity character controller, jetpack, mining beam, scanner, vitals/hazards, first/third person, interaction

m5_blackhole.desc: Black hole visuals (lensing, accretion disc) + mechanics, warp/hyperspace effect, transition into the destination system

m6_ui.desc: Main menu, HUD, pause menu, controls overview, galaxy map, system map, inventory, notifications

m7a_content.desc: Flora/rock/resource scattering, POIs and structures, interactables, prop tables, resource nodes

m7b_life.desc: Fauna, weather particle effects, system extras (station, freighter, satellites, asteroid fields)

m8_audio.desc: Procedural audio: engine, pulse, wind/ambience by biome, footsteps, UI sounds, warnings (AudioStreamWAV/Generator created in code)
